title: bddo:ibmHexadecimal reads IBM hexadecimal floating point
description: C2 76 A0 00: sign 1, exponent 0x42, fraction 0x76A000, so -0x76A000 x 16^(66-64-6) = -118.625. 42 01 00 00 is not normalised and is read by the same formula: 0x010000 x 16^-4 = 1.0. The 64-bit 41 10 00 00 00 00 00 00 is 2^52 x 16^-13 = 1.0.
